items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal may go with a smaller rise in sugar, and walking 10 to 19 minutes got most of the gain. If you take insulin or a sulfonylurea, ask your care team about low sugar before adding walks after meals.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Sugar rose more after late dinners, so try to start dinner before 8 pm. About 33.3% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 12.1 hours, and you may want to try to reach 13 hours. In the program, adding the overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points.
